mainImage.alt: Striking PECO workers carrying signs on a picket line outside company headquarters in Philadelphia on July 4, 2026
mainImage.caption: PECO workers form picket lines outside company headquarters in Philadelphia on July 4, 2026, during the first strike in the utility's 145-year history.

body.alt: Nurses holding signs on a picket line outside University Medical Center in New Orleans during their sixth strike, one sign reads We Need a Contract NOW
body.caption: Nurses at University Medical Center in New Orleans on the picket line during their sixth strike, demanding their first union contract after more than 765 days of stalled negotiations.

body.alt: Mass General Brigham nurses in scrubs holding signs announcing their July 8, 2026 strike date
body.caption: Mass General Brigham nurses and clinicians announced plans to strike on July 8, 2026. More than 4,000 nurses at Brigham and Women's Hospital will walk out in potentially the largest nursing strike in Massachusetts history.
body.credit: Mass General Brigham / MGB Nurses Union
